# Simply Black and White
## Web Accessibility & AEO Consultancy

> Simply Black and White provides web accessibility audits, digital accessibility remediation, and Answer Engine Optimization consultancy. We help businesses make their websites accessible to everyone — without the intimidation, the jargon, or the judgment.

## What We Do

- Web accessibility audits and compliance assessments
- Digital accessibility remediation planning and developer-ready workbooks
- Ongoing accessibility monitoring and re-scanning
- Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) — structuring websites so AI search engines can read, understand, and recommend businesses
- AEO health scoring and AI search visibility analysis

## Our Services

- The Clear View Audit: Comprehensive accessibility audit with a full scan report, plain-language fix recommendations, AEO citation readiness check, and prioritized developer checklist.
- The Clean Slate Orchestration: Full architectural remediation planning with developer-ready workbooks, code-level fix specifications, and platform-specific guidance.
- The Always Open Guardian: Continuous accessibility monitoring, recurring re-scans, AEO citation tracking, and quarterly compliance tune-ups.

## Who We Help

- Small and mid-size business owners who inherited inaccessible websites
- Agencies and development teams needing accessibility guidance
- Organizations preparing for DOJ Title II web accessibility compliance
- Businesses wanting to improve their AI search engine visibility

## Our Approach

We position ourselves as a helpful ally rather than an intimidating auditor. We understand that most website accessibility issues stem from inherited templates, third-party plugins, and previous agencies — not intentional neglect. We provide clear, actionable remediation plans in plain language.

- Website: https://simplyblackandwhite.com

- Standards: WCAG AAA aligned, DOJ Title II ready
